ophiuchus.title: Ophiuchus
ophiuchus.headline: Ophiuchus: The 13th Zodiac Sign
ophiuchus.alt_default: Ophiuchus, the 13th zodiac sign, illustrated as the serpent bearer in original astrology artwork.
ophiuchus.summary: Ophiuchus, the serpent bearer, explored through a 13-sign astrology framework.
about: Ophiuchus is a constellation that sits between Scorpius and Sagittarius. It is traditionally pictured as a figure holding a serpent, which is where its name, the serpent bearer, comes from.

The Sun passes through the constellation Ophiuchus every year, roughly from late November to mid-December. That is why some astrologers work with a 13-sign zodiac that includes Ophiuchus alongside the familiar twelve.
